The bus stops at your old school. The doors open. A hand grabs your arm. Don't get off.
Last time, a whisper said don't give him your ticket.
In the last row, a girl. Purple jacket, green beanie. Zoe.
I gave him my ticket, she says. Three days ago. He never lets me off.
The fog opens. Your old school. Same red door.
You step toward the doors. Zoe pulls you back.

text: Get off at a memory, she says, and you stay there. Forever.

The doors close. Then the sign flickers again.

text: Would you get off at your house? Comment yes or no.
